args.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent children's character key pose, exactly ONE full-body cream companion. Draw a FRESH NEW illustration from scratch, not a pixel patch, in the identical soft warm picture-book watercolour style of these references. Input1: adopted identity/cream palette/brown contour/eyes/ears/tail reference. Input2: exact target happy airborne gesture and proportions to recreate. Inputs3 and4: neighboring ready and landing poses, for consistent character, body size and line/paper feel. Target: the same cream cat-like companion happily jumping, both arms raised outward, two feet lifted and turned forward, one single curved tail on viewer's left, closed happy crescent eyes, single brown nose, open pink smile. Keep the same large rounded head, two triangular pink-inner ears, slender short torso, compact paws, warm light cream body, subtle soft peach paper grain, gently textured medium-brown outline and simple paw marks. Recreate the target geometry faithfully while making both shoulder-to-upper-arm connections smooth, solid and clean. Brown shoulder fold lines must be simple single strokes over continuous opaque cream paint, without triangular cutouts, doubled strokes or transparent slits inside body/neck/arms. This is still a lightly anthropomorphic character, not a real animal. Preserve the original gentle line weight and tonal softness, avoid darker/harder vector line or bleaching the fill. Full ears/tail/paws visible, generous transparent margin on every side. Genuine transparent PNG outside silhouette; keep subtle opaque paper texture inside, no alpha holes. No ground, shadow, props, text, watermark, extra limbs or second character.
